sources.title: Fruit Zombie Survival | Play on Roblox
sources.excerpt: By Vibed Games. Eat a Devil Fruit and unlock its power; collect 20 fruits; survive endless zombie waves with special bosses; pick a One Piece character to place special builds; farm Berries; team up with up to 4 friends and climb global leaderboards.

sources.title: Fruit Zombie Survival Codes (September 2026)
sources.excerpt: Fruit Zombie Survival is a Roblox survival game where players eat a Devil Fruit, take its power, and try not to get eaten by zombies. The article reports rewards including diamonds, a crate roll, a spare revive, and a new Artifact Crate Roll with 2x Luck.
